releases.body:
ADU design-build specialist Acton ADU to appear on All Access with Andy Garcia as an industry expert on how accessory dwelling units are reshaping housing for families across California and the United States

CAMPBELL, Calif., Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Accessory dwelling units are now one of the fastest-growing forms of housing in America, and Acton ADU is helping a national audience understand why. The California design-build company, which specializes exclusively in ADUs, was selected as an industry specialist for All Access with Andy Garcia, an educational series airing on Public Television stations nationwide. The segment explores the ADU movement and its growing impact on families and homeowners across California and the country.

The feature arrives as ADU growth hits record levels. California issued 41,831 ADU permits in 2025, an all-time high and a more than thirtyfold increase from the 1,336 permitted in 2016, with ADUs accounting for roughly a quarter of all new homes permitted statewide (California Department of Housing and Community Development Annual Progress Report data, as of the September 2026 release). In Los Angeles and San Francisco, more permits were issued for ADUs in 2025 than for all other forms of housing combined (Cotality, as of 2025). In Los Angeles County alone, a record 10,200+ ADUs were completed in 2025, accounting for 37 percent of the county's new housing (USC Lusk Center for Real Estate).

"The most important thing happening in California housing isn't downtown, it's in backyards," said Stan Acton, founder of Acton ADU. "Families are using ADUs to keep aging parents close, give adult children an affordable place to land, and build lasting value on property they already own. That's a generational shift in how Americans think about home, and it's why we were honored to help tell this story on Public Television."

In the segment, Acton ADU explains what ADUs are, why demand for backyard homes has accelerated, and how thoughtful small-home design determines whether an ADU performs for decades. The company also shares the thinking behind Family Integrity Planning, its framework for helping homeowners use ADUs to keep generations close, care for the people they love, and grow long-term value at home.

Founded on more than 35 years of residential construction experience, Acton ADU has completed hundreds of projects across California and serves homeowners throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, East Bay, San Gabriel Valley, and greater Los Angeles county.

The segment featuring Acton ADU will begin distribution on October 26, 2026 on more than 170 participating Public Television stations nationwide, and will air through October 2027.

Interview Availability

Acton ADU founder Stan Acton is available for media interviews on:

  • The ADU movement and California housing policy, including the rise of pre-approved ADU plans
  • Multigenerational living and Family Integrity Planning
  • Why designing a small home well is harder than designing a big one
  • What homeowners should know before building an ADU

To schedule an interview, contact James Parks at info@actonadu.com.

About Acton ADU

Acton ADU is a California design-build company specializing in accessory dwelling units. Serving homeowners throughout the San Francisco Bay Area, East Bay, and San Gabriel Valley, Acton ADU provides an all-in-one partnership covering feasibility, design, permitting, construction, and warranty. Every project is built to perform for decades, backed by a proven process built on No Surprises, Thoughtful Procedures, and Pride and Quality. Learn more at ActonADU.com.

releases.body:
From the Yankees clubhouse to baseball's looming labor showdown, Sturtze and host Shana Orczyk Sissel examine the money, power and financial risks reshaping professional sports.

LIVE TODAY: Tuesday, October 20, 2026 | 12:00 PM ET

WASHINGTON, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CrossCheck Media Inc. today announced that former Major League Baseball pitcher Tanyon Sturtze, who spent 12 seasons in the major leagues, including three with the New York Yankees, will appear live on Franchise Value today at 12:00 PM Eastern Time on Biz Talk Today TV (BTT).

The episode will stream live on the CrossCheck Media YouTube channel and across Biz Talk Today TV's distribution network.

Hosted by Shana Orczyk Sissel, CEO and Founder of Banríon Capital Management and author of Tough Minded, Franchise Value examines the increasingly sophisticated business of professional sports, where franchise valuations, labor negotiations, media rights and financial markets collide.

Today's episode brings an unusually revealing perspective to that conversation.

Sturtze experienced professional baseball from both ends of the financial spectrum. He was an Opening Day starter for the Tampa Bay Devil Rays, one of baseball's lowest-payroll organizations, before joining the New York Yankees and becoming a key member of manager Joe Torre's pitching staff.

His career offers firsthand insight into the financial realities facing professional athletes, from negotiating contracts and competing for roster spots to managing injuries that can abruptly change a player's earning potential.

Now working in the insurance industry, Sturtze brings a second perspective to the business of sports: how athletes, teams and financial institutions evaluate and manage risk.

Baseball's Billion-Dollar Labor Battle

The conversation arrives at a pivotal moment for Major League Baseball.

With the league's collective bargaining agreement scheduled to expire December 1, 2026, owners and players are confronting potentially consequential negotiations over salary caps, minimum payroll requirements, revenue sharing and the possibility of another work stoppage.

At the center of the debate is competitive balance.

The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers are preparing to meet in the World Series despite operating with substantially smaller payrolls than many of baseball's biggest-market franchises.

Their success raises an important question: Does Major League Baseball need a salary cap to create competitive balance, or would a cap primarily give owners greater control over labor costs?

Sissel and Sturtze will explore that question through the experiences of a former player who competed for both a small-market organization and the New York Yankees.

Inside the Yankees Clubhouse

Beyond baseball's labor negotiations, viewers can expect a firsthand look at life inside one of professional sports' most recognizable franchises.

Sturtze will discuss his experiences in the major leagues, the differences between small-market and big-market organizations, and the financial pressures facing players whose careers depend on performance, health and contract negotiations.

The discussion will also examine how injuries can affect an athlete's financial future and why insurance and risk management have become increasingly important components of professional sports.

When Athletes Become Financial Assets

Today's episode will also explore a developing intersection between Wall Street and professional athletics.

From sports-related futures contracts and proposed investment funds to platforms offering investors exposure to athletes' future earnings, financial innovation is creating new ways to participate in the economics of professional sports.

But those developments raise significant questions about regulation, insider information, athlete compensation and financial risk.

Sissel and Sturtze will examine who benefits from these emerging financial products, who bears the risk and whether the athletes themselves are adequately protected.

The conversation will also touch on rising franchise valuations, media-rights economics and the expanding role of institutional capital in professional sports.

TORONTO, Oct. 6, 2026 /CNW/ -- Asian Television Network International Limited (ATN) (TSXV: SAT), Canada's largest South Asian broadcaster and pioneer broadcaster of cricket is pleased to announce that it has acquired the Canadian broadcast rights to the National Cricket League GT20 (NCLGT20), bringing the exciting new T20 cricket league to audiences across Canada.

The NCLGT20 features some of the biggest names in international cricket, combining established cricket legends with leading international and emerging talent in a fast-paced T20 format.

Through this agreement, ATN will air live coverage of NCLGT20 matches across its sports channels in Canada, making the tournament accessible to cricket fans across the country.

"We are delighted to bring a lot more exciting Live Cricket to the Canadian audiences," said Dr. Shan Chandrasekar, President and CEO of ATN. "Cricket continues to be one of the most important sports for Canada's Commonwealth Communities, and ATN is committed to bringing our viewers the best cricket from around the world. NCLGT20 provides an exciting new platform featuring some of the most recognizable names in the game, and we look forward to making this tournament available to cricket fans throughout Canada."

The NCL GT20 Canada tournament has formed a historic partnership with Cricket West Indies (CWI) to host its 2026 season in the Caribbean. The professional T20 franchise tournament will take place in St. Vincent and the Grenadines from October 23 to November 1, 2026, before returning to Canada for its 2027. Organized in direct collaboration with Cricket Canada and CWI, the temporary relocation aims to strengthen cricketing, developmental, and commercial links between North America and the Caribbean.

Chris Dehring, Chief Executive Officer of Cricket West Indies, said: "NCL GT20 Canada, together with the deep cricketing tradition of the West Indies, creates an exciting opportunity for collaboration. Hosting the 2026 tournament in the Caribbean before its return to Canada next year marks the beginning of a partnership that can facilitate the continued development of Canadian cricket while showcasing our region as one of the great cricketing regions of world cricket. As the only full member of the ICC in the hemisphere, we believe it is important to forge mutually beneficial relationships with ICC Associate Members across the region, for the health of the game and, indeed, for the continued development of West Indies cricket."

"Every ball, every six, every wicket -- live, coast to coast," said Malini Basu, Chief Global Communications Officer for NCL GT20. "This league was built for Canada, and with cricket headed to the 2028 Olympics, Canadian fans deserve a front-row seat to the players who will shape the sport's next chapter. We're excited to work with ATN to bring NCL GT20 to cricket fans across Canada" she added.

All the 18 NCLGT20 matches will be available LIVE across Canada on ATN Cricket Plus, CBN, & ATN Sports.

Adding to the NCLGT20 lineup, ATN will also air the New Zealand vs. India series LIVE from October 22 through November 30, 2026. The highly anticipated series will feature: 5 - T20 Internationals, 5 - One-Day Internationals (ODIs) & 2 - Test Matches. Recognizing that the supply side was the next frontier in its performance discipline, Diray identified MCG's buy-side-focused optimization as the missing layer — one that structures and continuously improves the streaming supply behind Diray's campaigns before it ever reaches the bid.

Diray has built its reputation on turning media into measurable business impact— by scoring every placement against client outcomes and adjusting until performance improves. Diray identified the supply side as the next lever in that discipline and chose MCG to shape supply procurement upstream, before a placement is ever won. MCG's distinct approach to securing streaming inventory starts with Diray's sophisticated buying practices, using those insights to shape higher-quality, more relevant supply before it reaches the bid. The two functions were built to work together: Diray's technology proves out what happens after the buy; MCG's optimization shapes what is available to buy in the first place.

What the partnership delivers for Diray Media's clients. Diray now pairs its optimization technology with an upstream supply layer of its own choosing: MCG continuously analyzes and shapes the supply behind Diray's campaigns — reducing exposure to low-value or over-concentrated inventory before it reaches the DSP and expanding reach on the sources that perform. As a single, neutral, buy-side-only layer across the major supply platforms Diray runs on.. The result, as Diray designed it, is a cleaner operational layer: ready-to-activate deal IDs for the DSPs Diray already uses, ongoing visibility and control at the supply level, and more room for Diray's strategists and buyers to stay focused on client outcomes.

releases.title: CRTC takes action to improve information about cellphone coverage
releases.body:
GATINEAU, QC, Oct. 2, 2026 /CNW/ -- The CRTC is helping Canadians better understand where cellphone coverage is available and where there may be gaps.

Following a public consultation, the CRTC is introducing a new approach for how service providers report on their cellphone networks. This will give Canadians more detailed information about cellphone coverage in a specific area, making it easier to compare service options.

Canadians will also be able to report locations where coverage maps do not reflect their experience. This feedback will help improve the accuracy of information over time and provide a clearer picture of connectivity needs across Canada.

The CRTC collects data from service providers on their coverage and provides this information to Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED), which uses it for its National Broadband Map. Better data will help service providers and governments identify areas where there are gaps, supporting planning and investments that improve connectivity.

The CRTC is also making it easier for Canadians to find, compare and choose the Internet and cellphone services that meet their needs. Recent measures include eliminating extra fees on Internet and cellphone plans, improving how Canadians are notified about expiring contracts and discounts, giving Canadians more ways to change or cancel their plans and making it easier to compare Internet plans.

Quotes

"Better information leads to better decisions. By improving how cellphone coverage is reported and giving Canadians a way to flag gaps, we can build a clearer picture of connectivity across the country and help support better investment where it is needed."

- Vicky Eatrides, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer, CRTC

Quick facts

  • The CRTC is an independent quasi-judicial tribunal that regulates the Canadian communications sector in the public interest. The CRTC holds public consultations on telecommunications and broadcasting matters and makes decisions based on the public record.
  • The new standard will be phased in beginning with the next Annual Facilities Survey in early 2027.
  • The Consumer Protections Action Plan sets out the actions the CRTC is taking to protect and empower Canadians.

ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LG Electronics (LG) announced a partnership with digital games leader Miniclip to launch the global hit mobile game 8 Ball Pool on LG Smart TVs, marking its first availability on the big screen. Recognized by Guinness World Records as the most downloaded mobile pool game, with more than 1 billion downloads worldwide, 8 Ball Pool will be available free-to-play on LG Smart TVs and monitors running webOS 6.0 and above in 165 countries, starting this week.

Bringing 8 Ball Pool to TV Screens

For its big-screen at-home debut, 8 Ball Pool has been optimized for the webOS platform with a dynamic user interface, allowing players to aim, adjust power and shoot with intuitive precision using the LG Magic Remote. The game also offers optional in-game items for purchase, adding opportunities for fun and personalization.

Recognizing the TV's unique role as the centerpiece of living room entertainment, LG and Miniclip are introducing the all-new Couch Play Mode, an exclusive feature for this release. This specialized mode adds 1-on-1 multiplayer gameplay, allowing two users to compete head-to-head on the same screen and bringing family and friends together for shared, competitive fun from the comfort of the sofa. To celebrate the launch, LG and Miniclip are offering exclusive items specially designed for LG TV users.

The game can be accessed via LG Apps or the LG Gaming Portal. In the Gaming Portal, users can also collect special rewards, such as badges in My Page, by completing tasks.

Advancing High-Quality Free Gaming to TV Screens

The launch of 8 Ball Pool further reinforces LG's continued momentum in TV gaming, bringing one of the most recognizable casual gaming experiences to the connected TV screen. With high-quality graphics, intuitive gameplay and free access, the title is expected to help drive stronger engagement across LG's gaming platform and support the continued evolution of CTV gaming into a more mainstream entertainment experience.

LG has tripled the number of web-based gaming titles available across its platform over the last two years1, expanding its library to more than 1,000 free-to-play games. This expanded library has contributed to stronger user engagement, with overall gaming usage increasing by 67 percent year over year2. Total hours played grew by 71 percent, while individual gaming sessions rose by 50 percent, underscoring the growing role of LG Smart TVs as an entertainment and gaming destination.

Delivering a Life-Size Experience at Home

On LG's screens over 100 inches, including LG's latest QNED evo and Micro RGB TVs, 8 Ball Pool comes to life at real-world scale3, creating an immersive at-home experience that players can enjoy with just a remote controller.

"Through this partnership, LG continues to expand its free premium gaming ecosystem on the webOS platform," said Chris Jo, head of the webOS Platform Business Center at the LG Media Entertainment Solution Company. "With new hit titles customized for big-screen players, LG is transforming the traditional TV into an interactive hub for home entertainment."

LG remains committed to enhancing LG Gaming Portal with compelling, new titles and convenient features, enabling users to enjoy the excitement of big-screen gaming directly on LG Smart TVs and Smart Monitors. To learn more, visit LG.com.

releases.body:
FBN Expands "The Big Money" Franchise with "Big Money in the Morning" Hosted by Dagen McDowell, Brian Brenberg, Taylor Riggs with Barron's Josh Schafer

Liz Claman to Launch New Friday Night Program "Claman's Power Players"

NEW YORK, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX Business Network (FBN) will unveil a new weekday programming lineup beginning on Monday, October 12th, announced FOX News Media President and Executive Editor Jay Wallace.

FBN will launch Big Money in the Morning (6-9AM/ET) hosted by Dagen McDowell, Brian Brenberg and Taylor Riggs with Barron's Josh Schafer. The Bottom Line will conclude its 6PM/ET run as McDowell and Brenberg transition to the morning show, with encore episodes of FBN's Kudlow taking over the 6 PM/ET timeslot. The Big Money Show (12-2PM/ET) will add rotating co-hosts Cheryl Casone, Marcus Lemonis, and Lou Basenese alongside current host Jackie DeAngelis. Additionally, Liz Claman will launch a new Friday night program entitled Claman's Power Players (7-7:30 PM/ET).

In making the announcement, Wallace said, "We're excited to bring viewers fresh programming from a seasoned team of journalists, offering expert insight and analysis on the forces shaping the economy and driving business news. FOX Business remains committed to delivering compelling business news, market analysis, and conversation throughout the day, and these changes will further strengthen our weekday lineup."

Claman's Power Players (Fridays, 7-7:30PM/ET) will feature industry titans, business leaders and creators on what will move Wall Street and Main Street in the week ahead. Since joining FBN as an anchor when the network launched in October 2007, Claman has conducted exclusive interviews with Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook, JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon, world leaders, nearly every U.S. Treasury Secretary as well as celebrities and athletes about their business ventures. Notably, her first interview on FBN in 2007 was with legendary investor Warren Buffett. Her afternoon program The Claman Countdown routinely ranks among the top ten shows in all of financial news and has become a premier destination for CEOs, business leaders, and influential voices shaping the global economy. Claman also hosts the FOX News Podcast Everybody Talks to Liz Claman featuring today's most successful business leaders, entrepreneurs and executives that discuss motivational stories about their journey.

Featuring a mix of breaking business news, debate and analysis, Big Money in the Morning will provide a comprehensive look at the issues driving the market to help viewers navigate the forces shaping their financial future ahead of the trading day. McDowell joined FOX News Channel in 2003 and was a founding anchor of FBN when the channel launched in 2007. She previously served as a business day and evening anchor and throughout her career has conducted several news-generating interviews, including most recently with First Lady Melania Trump on The Big Money Show, as well as former Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson, former Secretary of State and First Lady Hillary Clinton, financier Charles Schwab and former Labor Secretary Eugene Scalia.

Brenberg joined FBN in 2020 and has co-hosted The Big Money Show and The Bottom Line. Prior to this, he served as an Associate Professor and Chair of the Program in Business and Finance at The King's College in New York City and worked in financial services and public policy research. Riggs joined FBN in 2022 from Bloomberg where she co-anchored a daily program covering equities, bonds, currencies, and commodities. She also led Bloomberg's cross-asset market coverage and was a municipal bond reporter. Schafer currently serves as a contributor across FBN and serves as Barron's Investor Circle Newsletter Editor. Prior to joining Barron's, he covered markets and the economy at Yahoo Finance. 

Since launching in 2023, The Big Money Show has offered viewers a fast-paced look at the trading day covering topics ranging from Wall Street markets to personal finance. Current host Jackie DeAngelis will be joined by Cheryl Casone and FBN contributors Marcus Lemonis and Lou Basenese who will serve as rotating co-hosts of the program. Casone was part of the team that launched FBN in 2007, previously serving as an anchor across the network's dayparts while providing financial analysis across FOX News Media's platforms, including the weekly job reports. She also hosted American Dream Home on FOX Nation. DeAngelis has co-hosted The Big Money Show since 2023. Prior to joining FBN in 2019, she spent 13 years at CNBC as the network's chief energy correspondent and later served as the anchor of Yahoo Finance's midday program.

Lemonis is a successful entrepreneur who has provided analysis on business and economic issues as a contributor across FBN and all FOX News Media platforms since joining FOX earlier this year. He is the executive chairman and CEO of Beyond where he has helped spearhead the transformation of the iconic Bed Bath & Beyond and Buy Buy Baby brands into a global e-commerce leader. Previously, he hosted The Profit on CNBC, which earned Critics Choice and Reality Television Award nominations. Basenese joined FBN in 2025 and provides financial analysis across the network. He also serves as executive vice president of market strategy at Prairie Operating Co (PROP) and is the founder of the financial news site, TheBigSkinny.com.   

WEEKDAY PROGRAMMING SCHEDULE 

  • 5-6AM/ET: FOX Weather AM 
  • 6-9AM/ET: Big Money in the Morning
  • 9AM-12PM/ET: Varney & Co.
  • 12-2PM/ET: The Big Money Show
  • 2-3PM/ET: Making Money with Charles Payne
  • 3-4PM/ET: The Claman Countdown
  • 4-5PM/ET: Kudlow
  • 5-6PM/ET: The Evening Edit
  • 6-7PM/ET: Encore episodes of Kudlow
  • Fridays, 7-7:30PM/ET: Claman's Power Players
  • Fridays, 7:30-8PM/ET: Barron's Roundtable

FOX Business Network (FBN) is a financial news channel delivering real-time information across all platforms that impact both Main Street and Wall Street. Headquartered in New York — the business capital of the world — FBN launched in October 2007 and is currently the top business channel on television. The network is available in more than 60 million homes in all markets across the United States and live streamed on FOX One. FBN is a unit of FOX News Media and has bureaus in Chicago, Los Angeles, and Washington, D.C.

releases.title: FOX NEWS MEDIA EXPANDS PODCAST PORTFOLIO WITH NEW ORIGINAL SHOW "the GIRLS" DEBUTING OCTOBER 1
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Podcasts will broaden its original podcast slate with FOX News' the Girls, a new personality-driven conversation series featuring an array of leading female voices. The announcement was made today by FOX News Digital and New Media President Porter Berry and Megan Albano, Executive Vice President of Morning Programming & Program Development. "the Girls" will debut on October 1st, with new episodes dropping every Thursday across all podcast platforms, including FOX News Digital, YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts.

Each episode of FOX News' the Girls will include a rotating cast of co-hosts week to week, moving beyond the traditional news roundtable for a free-flowing conversation that can go anywhere — politics and pop culture; money and marriage; parenting, relationships, careers, or the group chat-worthy story of the day. Nothing is off the table. Showcasing multiple distinct perspectives, the conversation will revolve naturally around the issues impacting real life with undeniable chemistry, refreshing candor and no script. The first episode will feature FOX News Media stars Rachel Campos-Duffy, Harris Faulkner and Kat Timpf, newly named FOX News contributor Melissa DeRosa and former ESPN host Samantha Ponder.

In commenting on the announcement, Berry said, "the Girls is a natural addition to our growing podcast portfolio, and we're thrilled to continue expanding our slate of distinctive shows that complement our existing lineup while creating new opportunities for our audience to engage with our content."

Albano added, "We're excited to deliver a no-holds-barred format that captures the authenticity and perspectives of the many dynamic women of FOX News Media and beyond."

Bringing together unique female voices and experiences spanning news, politics, sports, comedy and culture, the premiere episode will feature a variety of viewpoints and backgrounds:

  • Rachel Campos-Duffy joined FNC in 2016 and currently co-hosts FOX & Friends Weekend. A mother of nine, she is a New York Times bestselling author and previously appeared on MTV's The Real World.
  • Emmy Award-winning journalist Harris Faulkner has been with FNC since 2005 and anchors The Faulkner Focus and co-hosts Outnumbered. She is also a New York Times bestselling author and mother of two daughters.
  • Kat Timpf, who joined FNC in 2015, is a panelist on Gutfeld!, comedian and two-time New York Times bestselling author. A mother and breast cancer survivor, she has spoken candidly about motherhood, loss, and her cancer diagnosis.
  • Veteran democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa previously held several senior roles in former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo's administration, becoming the first woman to serve as secretary to the governor.
  • Samantha Ponder is a former host of ESPN's Sunday NFL Countdown and a mother of three children.

The new podcast is the latest addition to FOX News Media's new media division which features an established suite of podcasts including Hang Out with Sean Hannity, Ruthless, Will Cain Country, Planet Tyrus and The Riley Gaines Show. 

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Podcasts, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer streaming services FOX Nation, and FOX News International and the free ad-supported television service FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for over 24 consecutive years, while FBN is the top business channel on cable. FOX News Media reaches nearly 200 million people each month and is also available to live stream on FOX One.

National jewelry retailer will nearly double its TikTok livestream hours and cement its position as one of TikTok Shop's premier jewelry partners, delivering 56 hours of programming from September 28th through October 4th

KNOXVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- JTV®, the national jewelry retailer and broadcast network, today announced the next chapter of its strategic partnership with TikTok Shop: a weeklong Grand Opening Event taking place September 28th through October 4th. Marking JTV's largest-ever investment in discovery e-commerce, the celebration will bring JTV's signature jewelry shopping experience to TikTok Shop (@jtv_jewelrytelevision) through expanded livestream programming, collaborations with leading creators, new product launches, special programming and giveaways.

In celebration of the grand opening, JTV will expand its TikTok Shop (@jtv_jewelrytelevision) livestream schedule from 30 hours to 56 hours for the week (a nearly 87% increase), giving viewers more opportunities than ever to discover and shop jewelry and gemstones in real time. The event will feature live product demonstrations, interactive programming and direct engagement with JTV hosts, jewelry experts and participating creators.

Throughout the week, JTV will partner with top-tier creators for special live events and original video content designed to introduce the brand's extensive assortment and accessible approach to jewelry shopping to new audiences.

The event is an example of JTV's broader strategy to leverage LIVE shopping on TikTok Shop to reach new audiences and engage with its community. As shopping increasingly moves to short-form video and creator-led platforms, JTV is applying more than 30 years of broadcast retail expertise (honed across 24/7 television programming reaching approximately 60 million U.S. and Canadian households) to a new generation of digital-first jewelry shoppers. The Grand Opening Event reflects a broader, sustained investment in creator partnerships and livestream production, positioning JTV as one of TikTok Shop's leading jewelry destinations and reinforcing the platform as a key growth channel within JTV's omnichannel strategy.

"TikTok Shop (@jtv_jewelrytelevision) has created an exciting new way for consumers to discover products, engage with creators and connect directly with brands," said Bart Sichel, President. "Through this next chapter of our partnership with TikTok Shop, we're bringing the expertise, entertainment and sense of discovery our customers know and love to an even broader audience. This Grand Opening Event is just the beginning of what we believe will be a defining growth channel for JTV."

The Grand Opening Event on TikTok Shop (@jtv_jewelrytelevision) will include:

  • 56 hours of livestream programming (a nearly 87% increase over JTV's typical weekly TikTok Shop schedule of 30 hours)
  • Live appearances and original content from leading TikTok Shop creators like @shopbluewaters, @faithfessel, @thenashvilleblonde2, @dobs284 and more.
  • Special themed programming and interactive shopping experiences
  • New product launches
  • Giveaways and additional surprises throughout the week

Viewers can join JTV's Grand Opening Event on TikTok Shop from September 28th through October 4th by following @JTV on TikTok and on TikTok Shop (@jtv_jewelrytelevision). Additional event details and programming updates will be shared through JTV's official social media channels.

Customers can also learn more about JTV by visiting JTV.com and following @JTV on Instagram, @jtv on Facebook, @jewelrytv on Pinterest, @JTV on TikTok and on TikTok Shop and @jewelry on X.

Headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee, JTV® (Jewelry Television) is one of the largest jewelry retailers and broadcast networks in the United States, with more than 30 years of experience bringing fine jewelry, gemstones and fashion accessories to millions of customers. Through its omnichannel strategy, JTV connects with audiences via 24/7 live television programming reaching approximately 60 million U.S. and Canadian households, an industry-leading e-commerce platform, JTV.com, and a fast-growing social media and social commerce presence, including its expanding role as one of TikTok Shop's leading jewelry partners.

releases.title: Dunamis Woman™ Enterprise Expands Into Original Media With Launch of Dunamis Woman™ TV Network
releases.body:
Inc. 5000-ranked faith-based enterprise unveils new television and podcast slate led by original docuseries, "House of Healing." Private Atlanta upfront and premiere screening set for Thursday, October 8.

ATLANTA, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dunamis Woman™ Enterprise has announced they are expanding their transformational work into television and digital media with the launch of the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network, a new streaming platform featuring original programming centered on healing, faith, identity, relationships, leadership and personal transformation. The initial slate will include the flagship docuseries, House of Healing, the Dunamis Woman Today TV show and original podcasts from Dunamis Woman™ Visionary Founder, Dr. Davetta "Dunamis Dee" Mallory, and her daughter COO and Visionary Builder, Ariel "Professor Ari" Fuller.

The expansion marks the next chapter for the mother-daughter-led enterprise, whose story began with Dr. Dee and Professor Ari doing the deeply personal work to heal their own relationship before helping other women do the same. What began as a calling has since grown into a multimillion-dollar faith-based enterprise serving more than 125,000 women globally and, most recently, earning the company the No. 3,465 spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list following 82% three-year revenue growth.

"When Dunamis Woman began, healing was personal. My daughter and I had to confront things in our own relationship before we could authentically help other women confront what was broken in theirs," said Dr. Dunamis Dee. "Since then, we have had the privilege of watching women do the courageous work of healing, reclaiming their identity and changing the trajectory of their families. I am incredibly proud of how far this vision has come, and I believe we are ready for this next chapter. Dunamis Woman TV gives us an opportunity to open the doors and let the world see what real healing looks like, and what becomes possible on the other side of it."

"We reached a point where we knew the transformation happening within Dunamis Woman could no longer be limited by how many people we could bring into a room," added Ariel. "My mother is the Visionary Leader, and I am the Visionary Builder, so my responsibility was to determine how we could translate what she created into media without losing the integrity of what makes it powerful. That required us to think beyond simply filming content and intentionally develop programming that could carry these stories, conversations and experiences to a much larger audience. Dunamis Woman TV is the result of that planning, and the beginning of how we take this impact to the world." 

To extend that impact, the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network will serve as the centralized home for the organization's original television, transformational storytelling and podcasts, bringing its growing body of programming together across digital and streaming platforms. The network's slate includes:

Dunamis Woman Today — Premieres Wednesday, October 5: A transformational, story-driven series highlighting real women and men from the Dunamis Woman™ community and their journeys through healing, faith, relationships and personal transformation. Hosted by Professor Ari, the series pairs personal storytelling with insight from Dr. Dee, who helps viewers understand the lessons behind each journey and apply them to their own lives.

House of Healing — Premieres Thursday, October 10: The network's flagship unscripted transformational docu-series follows real women, not actors, as they enter an immersive healing retreat to confront the wounds, mindsets, relationships and life experiences that have kept them bound. Led by Dr. Dunamis Dee, each retreat takes viewers inside the raw conversations, challenging exercises, therapeutic coaching and deeply personal breakthroughs that unfold as women uncover what lies beneath the problems they thought they came to solve, revealing that sometimes, the problem you walk in talking about isn't the real problem at all.

The Professor Ari Podcast — Premieres Sunday, October 11: A thought-leadership podcast for ambitious women building what they believe God has called them to carry. Through conversations about identity, leadership, faith, endurance, income and impact, Fuller draws from her experience as a young executive and entrepreneur to explore what it takes to build with both purpose and capacity.

The Dr. Dunamis Dee Podcast — Premieres Sunday, October 11: Filmed from the stylish setting of Dr. Dee's' Dunamis Woman Boutique, the podcast introduces audiences to another side of the Visionary Founder through candid conversations about confidence, relationships, self-esteem, wisdom and the freedom to become unapologetically who they were created to be.

Dunamis Woman™ will formally introduce its new media chapter to the entertainment industry on Thursday, October 8, 2026, with the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network Upfront & Premiere in Atlanta. The invitation-only event will bring together entertainment executives, producers, media, creators, influencers, cultural tastemakers and business leaders for an exclusive "first look" at the network's inaugural programming slate. Guests will experience programming previews and trailers, a premiere screening of House of Healing, and a moderated conversation with Dr. Dee, Professor Ari and select participants from the series, followed by an industry networking reception.

Dunamis Woman™ TV Network programming is available for streaming on Roku, Amazon and Android TV as well as through the Dunamis Woman TV Network App on iPhone and Android. To subscribe, visit https://www.dunamiswomantv.com/checkout/subscribe/signup.

For press inquiries, or to schedule interviews with Dr. Dee and Professor Ari, contact dunamis@cnbettermedia.com.

Media interested in attending and covering the Dunamis Woman™ TV Network Upfront & Premiere may apply for credentials here: https://bit.ly/DunamisUpfrontCredentials 

ABOUT DUNAMIS WOMAN™

Dunamis Woman™ is a global transformational movement committed to helping women heal emotionally, grow spiritually and walk boldly in their God-given authority. Rooted in the Greek word "dunamis," meaning miraculous power, the organization equips women to restore identity, strengthen faith, build legacy and live whole from the inside out through transformational teaching, leadership development, educational resources, community experiences and live events. With a growing international community of more than 125,000 women, Dunamis Woman™ continues to inspire a generation of women determined to move beyond survival and into purposeful, legacy-driven living. For more information, visit www.dunamis-woman.com and follow @DunamisWoman on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and X.

LG expands multi-year Television Academy partnership to showcase award-winning TVs and LG SIGNATURE luxury appliances on television's biggest night

News Summary:

  • LG Electronics returns for the 78th Emmy® Awards Season as the Official TV and Appliance Partner of the Television Academy.
  • LG SIGNATURE makes its official Emmy Red Carpet debut by hosting the on-site "LG SIGNATURE Influencer Lounge" at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, featuring live creator content and LG products.

ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Continuing its official partnership with the Television Academy, LG Electronics USA returns for the 78th Emmy® Awards Season as the Official TV and Appliance Partner. Building on last year's successful collaboration with LG, this year's partnership expands across LG's appliances to bring together cutting-edge TV technology and the latest-premium LG SIGNATURE appliance brand to television's biggest night.

As part of the Television Academy's official corporate partner roster, LG Electronics will elevate the Emmy Awards experience for nominees, creators and fans through comprehensive home entertainment and appliance activations.

For the first time, LG Electronics is bringing a unified home entertainment and home appliance experience directly to the Emmys Red Carpet at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles by hosting the "LG SIGNATURE Influencer Lounge." Situated steps from arrivals, this dedicated branded space bridges cinematic technology and quiet luxury, featuring state-of-the-art LG displays streaming live coverage alongside showcases of the new Tailored Collection and LG SIGNATURE Steam Closet. Throughout the evening, curated lifestyle creators and LG Ambassadors in the lounge will capture real-time, behind-the-scenes content with arriving nominees and stars, while high-impact digital billboards at Los Angeles' iconic shopping destination, The Grove, extend the Emmys celebration across the city.

"LG Electronics is proud to continue our partnership with the Television Academy for the 78th Emmys season," said Louis Giagrande, Head of Marketing at LG Electronics USA. "This partnership reflects our shared passion for cinematic excellence, design, and storytelling. By uniting our award-winning TV technology with our premium LG SIGNATURE appliances, LG is uniquely positioned to deliver complete, elevated home experiences that inspire audiences everywhere."

Elevating Artistry Across Kitchen, Laundry, and Living

Marking its official debut on the Emmys Red Carpet this season, LG SIGNATURE is honored to partner with the Television Academy in celebrating a shared devotion to artistry, storytelling, and the moments that move audiences worldwide. Believing that the artistry celebrated on screen belongs in the spaces where life unfolds, LG SIGNATURE's latest evolution in premium kitchen and laundry appliances brings a quiet luxury aesthetic into the home. Designed with pioneering touches that feel instantly familiar, these innovations are showcased across three new LG SIGNATURE collections (Iconic, Seamless, and Tailored), reflecting the belief that the best design, like the best storytelling, is felt long before it is noticed.

"We are delighted to expand our relationship with LG Electronics for the 78th Emmy Awards season," said Maury McIntyre, President and CEO of the Television Academy. "LG brings industry-leading technology to all its products, embodying the spirit of innovation and artistry that we celebrate on television's biggest night. We look forward to elevating how audiences experience the magic of television together."

Nationwide and International Consumer and Smart TV Integrations

To further enhance the Emmys season experience for consumers, LG is featuring a curated hub within LG Channels and webOS. The feature will bring together a curated selection of Emmy Award-winning and nominated content for LG TV owners, including SNL Vault, The Walking Dead Universe, Law & Order, The Price is Right, Family Feud, and more1.

This partnership will also tie into LG's consumer promotions during Streaming Week2 and feature high-impact billboard activations in New York's Times Square and London, alongside retail promotions across the U.S., giving LG owners access to exclusive deals from top streaming partners and making it easier than ever to enjoy their favorite Emmy-nominated shows and movies. In the UK, LG Channels will carry the Emmys live, while LG Nordics will offer the ceremony on demand.

The 78th Emmy Awards will telecast live from the Peacock Theater at L.A. LIVE in Los Angeles on Monday, Sept. 14, 2026, airing coast-to-coast on NBC and streaming live on Peacock at 8 p.m. ET/5p.m. PT.

NEW YORK, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The McBride Rewind, the celebrity interview podcast hosted by television personality Josh McBride, has signed with WME for representation in all areas and entered into an exclusive partnership with Acast, expanding the show's reach as it continues to gain momentum in the entertainment podcast space.

Since its debut earlier this year, The McBride Rewind has become known for candid conversations with actors, musicians and television personalities whose work helped define late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Recent guests include Whoopi Goldberg, Ja Rule, Jodie Sweetin, Christine Taylor, Andrew Keegan, Mýa and Nina Sky. Several episodes have generated follow-on coverage in outlets including People and Page Six, with conversations extending beyond nostalgia into topics such as residuals, career reinvention, and the changing realities of working in Hollywood.

Acast will provide global distribution, advertising sales, and monetization support, while WME will represent the podcast as it expands across digital media, branded content, live opportunities and additional entertainment ventures. "I've always believed the best interviews happen when people forget they're being interviewed," said McBride. "Those are the moments listeners connect with most. Every guest has a story that goes beyond the role or the hit song people remember, and that's what we've built the show around. Having Acast and WME behind us allows us to keep growing while staying true to that approach."

"Josh has created a format that feels both familiar and fresh," said Jaclyn Wertheimer, Senior Development Manager at Acast. "His guests are comfortable opening up, and those conversations often become part of larger entertainment news cycles. We're looking forward to bringing the show to an even wider audience and introducing new advertising partners to such an engaged fan base."

Rather than simply revisiting memorable moments from pop culture, The McBride Rewind focuses on the careers behind them. Guests reflect on the successes, challenges and turning points that shaped their lives, offering listeners a perspective that's both nostalgic and relevant to today's entertainment landscape.

With support from WME and Acast, the podcast will continue to expand its guest lineup while exploring new opportunities across audio, video and live programming.

The McBride Rewind is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube and wherever podcasts are distributed.

About Josh McBride

Josh McBride is a television host, producer and entertainment journalist with nearly 15 years of on-air experience. He has appeared on programs including Today, Good Morning America, The Wendy Williams Show, The Talk and numerous national and syndicated broadcasts. He is recognized for his conversational interview style and longstanding relationships throughout the entertainment industry.

About The McBride Rewind

The McBride Rewind is a weekly interview podcast featuring conversations with actors, musicians and entertainers whose work helped shape late-'90s and early-2000s pop culture. Each episode looks beyond the headlines, exploring the careers, creative journeys and personal stories behind some of entertainment's most recognizable names.
